headline: Bloomberg: Tesla Robotaxi Fleet Totals Just 59 Vehicles Despite Musk Promises — comprehensive critical feature traces history of missed autonomy timelines from Jul 2025 earnings call; Musk had promised 'half the US population' with autonomous ride-hailing by end of 2025; 59 total unsupervised vehicles across Austin, Dallas, Houston; LA Times echoes: 'robotaxis stall as self-driving hype hits real-world traffic'; TSLA -1.43% today, daily range $381.31–$397.09 (Bloomberg / LA Times, Jun 10, 2026)

SpaceX-Tesla merger speculation surges — Wedbush's Dan Ives puts odds at 80%+, Fortune models a combined $3.4T entity; SpaceX IPO filing contains merger clues and $3.75B insider windfall; Seeking Alpha upgrades TSLA to Buy on merger thesis; Kalshi prediction market tracking formal announcement; TSLA fell 1.43% on June 10 as investor concern mounts about dilution risk and regulatory complexity; Morningstar flags SpaceX defense contracts + Tesla China operations as potential blockade (Wedbush / Fortune / Seeking Alpha / Morningstar)

40 purpose-built Cybercabs spotted staged at dedicated Dallas robotaxi hub — dramatic jump from handful operating weeks ago; fleet activation described as imminent; no Cybercab is yet carrying passengers (all current unsupervised rides still use Model Y); aggressive Cybercab commercial activation tied to FSD v15 release (late 2026 / early 2027); staging confirms production ramp delivering vehicles for deployment (basenor.com / Medium, Jun 7, 2026)

Tesla rolls out FSD v14.3.3 (build 2026.14.6.6) with unified Spring Update branch merge — FSD Streak feature added; v14 Lite for legacy HW3 hardware confirmed for late June 2026 North American rollout, then Australia/New Zealand and global markets; v15 (10x parameter upgrade) expected end of 2026 at earliest, likely slipping to early 2027 per notateslaapp analysis (notateslaapp / yeslak, Jun 4, 2026)

Tesla expands unsupervised Robotaxi to entire Austin metro area — full city now bookable for the first time since launch; however only ~20 active vehicles operating vs the full metro map; expansion happened in two stages on June 3 morning; service confirmed for both day and evening hours (Electrek / notateslaapp)

Tesla FSD (Supervised) officially launches in China on May 21 — Tesla's X account confirmed FSD Supervised is now available to Chinese customers, one week after Musk's Beijing visit with Trump; follows years of delays; opens 1M+ GigaShanghai-built eligible vehicles; subscription-only model (one-time purchase globally discontinued Feb 2026); full unsupervised clearance still pending (CNBC / CnEVPost / SCMP)

Tesla Semi production live at Gigafactory Nevada + WattEV orders 370 trucks in $100M deal — first Tesla Semi rolls off high-volume line Apr 30; WattEV landmark order is California's largest-ever single electric truck purchase; 50 trucks in 2026, full fleet by end 2027 supporting Port of Oakland; Big F Transport also orders 40 units; fleet adoption accelerating across enterprise logistics sector (Electrek / Teslarati / ACT Expo)

Tesla China retail sales -10% YoY in April (25,956 units) — domestic retail -15% YoY; the widely-reported +36% 'surge' was wholesale/export-inflated (Giga Shanghai output including European and APAC exports, NOT Chinese consumer purchases); Q1 2026 China retail was -16% YoY with January alone crashing -45%; on current trajectory, Tesla risks falling behind Xiaomi in China market share by end of 2026; bear signal directly contradicting the China delivery recovery thesis (Electrek / CnEVPost)
